integrity: Analytic global proof plus exact-rational finite checker; publication-priority completeness is not guaranteed, and relevant older full text remained inaccessible.
scientific_limitations: Exact for real planar rotation-dilation generators, additive unrestricted or freely oriented rank-one corrections and spectral margin. Not a fixed-actuator, complex rank-one, nonlinear or high-dimensional result; strictly stable optima are only infima, and some boundary optimizers are defective.
title: Sharp rank-one stabilization cost and overdamping transition for a planar rotating mode
